rules.generated: a document under an obj/ or Generated/ folder, a *.g.cs/*.g.i.cs/*.Designer.cs, one whose first comment is <auto-generated>, or a source generator's output: measured for population, never reported
rules.lines: the declaration span of each authored partial (attributes in, leading comments out), summed; a nested type's lines count in its container too
rules.members: authored fields, methods, constructors, operators, properties, indexers and events (accessors and nested types not counted)
rules.fan: fanOut: distinct other census types the type's own code uses; fanIn: distinct product types using it; fanInTests: distinct test types using it; a type and its nested types are one unit
rules.folderNamespace: a partial agrees when its namespace is the project's root namespace plus its folders
rules.godClass: an authored type of at least 800 lines; data-ize when fields are at least 60% of its members
rules.clones: type-2: identical token-kind streams once identifiers and literals are canonicalized, over whole bodies of at least minTokens tokens (roslyn-analysis detect-clones.cs, default mode)

reach.used: authored or generated product code uses it outside its own body
reach.test-only: only a test project uses it
reach.unreferenced: nothing in the solution uses it — confirmed by SymbolFinder (cascading through overrides and implementations; an XML-doc cref is not a use)
reach.entry-point: the program entry point, a [ModuleInitializer], or a type that declares one
reach.implicit-call: a static constructor, a finalizer, or a parameterless instance constructor of a struct or of a class some source type derives from (the derived constructor's implicit base() call)
reach.framework-dispatch: overrides or implements a member declared outside the solution (the framework or a package calls it through the base or the interface)
reach.dispatch: overrides or implements a solution member that is itself used (the call binds to the root)
reach.reflection-attribute: the member or an enclosing type carries an attribute a framework discovers by reflection (ModuleInitializer, Roslyn Generator/DiagnosticAnalyzer, System.Text.Json.Serialization, DynamicDependency, UnmanagedCallersOnly, xunit, BenchmarkDotNet)
reach.serialized: a property of a type that reaches System.Text.Json serialization
reach.emitted-text: a member of the emitted surface (the runtime generated programs call) whose name is written inside a string literal or interpolated text of a code-generating project
reach.named-in-string: a type whose full name is a string literal somewhere in the solution (found by name)
reach.record-positional: a positional record property: the synthesized Equals, GetHashCode, ToString and Deconstruct read it
reach.enum-member: an enum member: its NAME is reachable through ToString, Parse and interpolation, which no reference query sees

deadArtifacts.classes: script: tracked files under scripts/ and tools/ (submodules excluded); doc: tracked docs/**/*.md (census records excluded); root-file: tracked repository-root files; test-scaffold: a test type with no test method and no user; drift-literal: a drift-test string naming a path or file that exists nowhere
deadArtifacts.query: a caller is a mention of the basename (the parent-qualified name when two tracked files share it) or a Python import, in any tracked text file but the artifact itself
deadArtifacts.notCallers: DEVLOG.md (history), closed kb/Work notes, and census records
